challenge.method: Extracted lines 11–19 from the pinned helper using the copyright line and the end of its contiguous comment block. Decoded the detail JSON and compared the ordered, case-folded alphanumeric tokens of the extracted span against the full licenseText field and the full standalone text. Tested adjacent lines, shortened spans, year and surname substitutions, the redistribution paragraph alone, and the SPDX template against both texts. Recomputed the UTF-8 byte lengths and SHA-256 digests of all four response bodies and checked the annotated tag target against both SPDX data URLs.
challenge.results: All three texts yielded the same 66 tokens in the same order and were identical as decoded text. The opening tokens include 2006, 2010 and Micah Cowan. The final tokens are modified, BSD and license. The preceding authorship line increased the count to 73, and including the following BEGIN line increased it to 67. Removing either boundary line, comparing the redistribution paragraph alone, or using the template failed against both SPDX texts. Changing 2010 to 2011 or Cowan to Cowen preserved the count but failed both comparisons.

limitations: The finding covers only the specified notice in the pinned helper and the two pinned SPDX representations. Other files, package-wide licensing, legal equivalence, redistribution and installation are outside scope.
The supplied claim digest identifies the record under review. The independent hash checks cover the four retrieved source bodies.

The fixed-source assessment used the requested SCES-1.0 framework and policy commit reference. The policy text was outside the four permitted acquisitions, so its contents were not independently verified.
reasoning: The pinned helper notice, the SPDX standalone text and the decoded detail field match across all 66 ordered tokens. Both SPDX data URLs use the commit named by the annotated v3.29.0 tag, and the boundary and substitution tests distinguish the claimed span from the tested near matches.
